<subject>Part-time Telecommuting Opportunity Inquiry</subject>
<body>
Dear Dr. Lefèvre,

I am interested in collaborating on a part-time, remote basis (approximately 1 to 2 days per week) for a duration of one to two years. I am available for on-site visits as needed. Please find attached a brief curriculum vitae for your consideration.

Might this opportunity be of interest to you? If there are no current openings, could you kindly recommend other departments or institutions that may have suitable positions? I look forward to your response.

Best regards,  
Antoine Durand  
Senior Research Associate  
Lumière Santé SAS  
Paris, France  
Tel: +33 1 45 67 89 00  
Email: a.durand@lumieresante.fr  
</body>
